pillars.label: Fiscal space and domestic resource mobilisation

indicators.label: Renewable energy consumption
indicators.description: Share of renewable energy in total final energy consumption (SDG 7.2.1). Includes traditional biomass, which raises the share in lower-income economies.
indicators.sourceName: IEA, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Carbon intensity of GDP
indicators.unit: kg CO2e per constant US$ of GDP
indicators.description: Carbon dioxide emissions, excluding land use, per unit of real GDP.
indicators.sourceName: EDGAR (EC Joint Research Centre), via World Development Indicators
indicators.caveat: The base year of the constant-price denominator is labelled differently across World Bank pages; the unit is read from the API at build time.

indicators.label: Access to electricity
indicators.description: Share of the population with access to electricity (SDG 7.1.1).
indicators.sourceName: Tracking SDG7 (World Bank ESMAP), via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Foreign direct investment, net inflows
indicators.description: Net inflows of investment to acquire a lasting management interest, as a share of GDP.
indicators.sourceName: IMF Balance of Payments, via World Development Indicators
indicators.caveat: Singapore's ratio reflects its role as a regional financial hub; much of the inflow is routed onward.

indicators.label: Gross capital formation
indicators.description: Outlays on additions to fixed assets plus net changes in inventories. A broad proxy for investment effort, including infrastructure.
indicators.sourceName: National accounts, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: International public finance for clean energy (SDG 7.a.1)
indicators.description: Official loans, grants and equity received for clean energy research and renewable energy production, including hybrid systems. Commitments, not disbursements.
indicators.sourceName: OECD and IRENA, via the UN SDG Global Database
indicators.caveat: Flows are lumpy because single large projects are recorded in the year of commitment. Use multi-year sums. Brunei and Singapore are not recipients.

indicators.label: Electricity production from coal
indicators.description: Share of electricity generated from coal. A proxy for where coal-dependent jobs and communities sit in the power system.
indicators.sourceName: IEA, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Vulnerable employment
indicators.description: Own-account and contributing family workers. These workers are least likely to have contracts, savings or social insurance when industries change.
indicators.sourceName: ILO modelled estimates, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Unemployment
indicators.description: Share of the labour force without work but available for and seeking employment.
indicators.sourceName: ILO modelled estimates, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Youth not in education, employment or training
indicators.description: Young people aged 15 to 24 who are neither working nor studying: the group most at risk of missing new green jobs.
indicators.sourceName: ILO, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Ratio of female to male labour force participation
indicators.description: Female labour force participation as a percentage of male participation. 100 means parity.
indicators.sourceName: ILO modelled estimates, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Employment in industry
indicators.description: Employment in mining, manufacturing, construction and utilities. The sectors where most transition job losses and gains concentrate.
indicators.sourceName: ILO modelled estimates, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Employment in agriculture
indicators.description: Employment in agriculture, forestry and fishing, which is exposed to climate impacts and to land-use change from bioenergy and hydropower.
indicators.sourceName: ILO modelled estimates, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Employment in mining and quarrying
indicators.description: Share of total employment in mining and quarrying (ISIC Rev. 4 section B), including coal mining. Computed from ILOSTAT employment counts from the same survey and year.
indicators.sourceName: ILOSTAT, International Labour Organization (employment by sex and economic activity)
indicators.caveat: Survey years differ by country; labour force surveys are used where available.

indicators.label: Employment in electricity, gas and steam supply
indicators.description: Share of total employment in electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply (ISIC Rev. 4 section D): the power-sector workforce that will change most as generation shifts.
indicators.sourceName: ILOSTAT, International Labour Organization (employment by sex and economic activity)
indicators.caveat: Survey years differ by country; labour force surveys are used where available.

indicators.label: Population covered by at least one social protection benefit (SDG 1.3.1)
indicators.description: Share of the population receiving at least one contributory or non-contributory social protection cash benefit, or actively contributing to a social security scheme.
indicators.sourceName: ILO, via the UN SDG Global Database
indicators.caveat: Available for a few years per country only.

indicators.label: Unemployed people receiving unemployment cash benefits (SDG 1.3.1)
indicators.description: Share of unemployed people who receive an unemployment cash benefit.
indicators.sourceName: ILO, via the UN SDG Global Database
indicators.caveat: Sparse: few members report, and in few years.

indicators.label: Employed people covered in case of work injury (SDG 1.3.1)
indicators.description: Share of employed people covered by employment injury protection.
indicators.sourceName: ILO, via the UN SDG Global Database
indicators.caveat: Sparse: few members report, and in few years.

indicators.label: Informal employment (SDG 8.3.1)
indicators.description: Share of employment that is informal, in all sectors (13th ICLS definition).
indicators.sourceName: ILO, via the UN SDG Global Database
indicators.caveat: Sparse and survey-based; several members have no recent value.

indicators.label: Fossil fuel energy consumption
indicators.description: Share of coal, oil, petroleum and natural gas products in total energy use.
indicators.sourceName: IEA, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Coal rents
indicators.description: Value of coal production at world prices minus production costs, relative to GDP. A measure of how much the economy and public revenue lean on coal.
indicators.sourceName: World Bank wealth accounts, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Human Development Index
indicators.description: Summary measure of a long and healthy life, knowledge and a decent standard of living.
indicators.sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report Office (HDR 2025)

indicators.label: Planetary pressures-adjusted HDI
indicators.description: The HDI discounted by a country's carbon dioxide emissions and material footprint per person.
indicators.sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report Office (HDR 2025)

indicators.label: HDI loss from planetary pressures
indicators.description: Percentage difference between the HDI and the PHDI. A larger loss means human development rests on heavier emissions and resource use.
indicators.sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report Office (HDR 2025)

indicators.label: Inequality-adjusted HDI
indicators.description: The HDI adjusted for inequality in each of its three dimensions.
indicators.sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report Office (HDR 2025)

indicators.label: CO2 emissions per capita (production)
indicators.description: Production-based carbon dioxide emissions per person. One of the two pressures used in the PHDI.
indicators.sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report Office (HDR 2025)

indicators.label: Material footprint per capita
indicators.description: Raw materials extracted to meet final demand, per person. The second pressure used in the PHDI.
indicators.sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report Office (HDR 2025)

indicators.label: GDP per capita, PPP
indicators.description: Gross domestic product per person, converted at purchasing power parity.
indicators.sourceName: World Bank ICP and national accounts, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: GDP per capita, constant US$
indicators.description: Gross domestic product per person in constant US dollars.
indicators.sourceName: National accounts, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: GDP per capita growth
indicators.description: Annual growth of real GDP per person.
indicators.sourceName: National accounts, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: General government expenditure
indicators.description: Total outlays of general government. The size of the public budget relative to the economy.
indicators.sourceName: IMF Fiscal Monitor

indicators.label: General government revenue
indicators.description: Taxes, social contributions, grants and other revenue of general government. The headline measure of domestic resource mobilisation.
indicators.sourceName: IMF Fiscal Monitor

indicators.label: Tax revenue
indicators.description: Compulsory transfers to central government for public purposes.
indicators.sourceName: IMF Government Finance Statistics, via World Development Indicators
indicators.caveat: Central government only, and coverage is uneven: there is no Viet Nam series.

indicators.label: General government net lending (+) / borrowing (-)
indicators.description: Revenue minus total expenditure of general government.
indicators.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook

indicators.label: General government gross debt
indicators.description: All liabilities of general government that are debt instruments.
indicators.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook
indicators.caveat: Singapore issues government securities to deepen its capital market and for investment, not to fund deficits; its debt is matched by assets.

indicators.label: External debt stocks
indicators.description: Total debt owed to non-residents, as a share of gross national income.
indicators.sourceName: World Bank International Debt Statistics
indicators.caveat: Brunei, Malaysia and Singapore do not report to the World Bank Debtor Reporting System.

indicators.label: Public and publicly guaranteed share of external debt
indicators.description: Long-term external debt owed or guaranteed by the public sector, as a share of total external debt.
indicators.sourceName: Derived from World Bank International Debt Statistics

indicators.label: Private non-guaranteed share of external debt
indicators.description: Long-term external debt of private borrowers without a public guarantee, as a share of total external debt.
indicators.sourceName: Derived from World Bank International Debt Statistics

indicators.label: Short-term share of external debt
indicators.description: Debt with an original maturity of one year or less, plus interest arrears on long-term debt.
indicators.sourceName: World Bank International Debt Statistics

indicators.label: Total external debt service
indicators.unit: % of exports of goods, services and primary income
indicators.description: Principal and interest paid on external debt, relative to export earnings.
indicators.sourceName: World Bank International Debt Statistics

indicators.label: Domestic credit to the private sector
indicators.description: Loans, purchases of non-equity securities, trade credit and other claims on the private sector by all financial corporations.
indicators.sourceName: IMF International Financial Statistics, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Domestic credit to the private sector by banks
indicators.description: Credit to the private sector from deposit-taking banks only.
indicators.sourceName: IMF International Financial Statistics, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Market capitalisation of listed domestic companies
indicators.description: End-of-year share price times shares outstanding for domestic companies listed on the country's exchanges.
indicators.sourceName: World Federation of Exchanges, via World Development Indicators
indicators.caveat: No series for economies without a functioning stock exchange of reporting size.

indicators.label: Value of stocks traded
indicators.description: Total value of shares traded during the year. A measure of market liquidity.
indicators.sourceName: World Federation of Exchanges, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Net ODA received
indicators.description: Disbursements of concessional loans and grants, net of repayments, as a share of gross national income.
indicators.sourceName: OECD Development Assistance Committee, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Share of total ASEAN net ODA received
indicators.description: Each country's net ODA receipts as a share of the sum across reporting ASEAN members in that year.
indicators.sourceName: Derived from OECD DAC data, via World Development Indicators

indicators.label: GDP, constant US$
indicators.sourceName: World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Population
indicators.sourceName: World Development Indicators

indicators.label: Net ODA received, current US$
indicators.sourceName: World Development Indicators

indicators.label: External debt stocks, total
indicators.sourceName: International Debt Statistics

indicators.label: External debt stocks, PPG
indicators.sourceName: International Debt Statistics

indicators.label: External debt stocks, PNG
indicators.sourceName: International Debt Statistics
